svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Coupling: cut 35 mm of 40 mm steel bar, faces square (drill press).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 22.2 mm hole 30 mm deep in one face (step up from 10 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross drill 6.2 mm through the centre, 12 mm from that face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the other face drill and tap three M5 holes 8 deep on a 28 mm circle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacer: cut a 56 mm disc from 10 mm G-11. Three 5.5 mm holes on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 28 mm circle, counterbored 10 mm across and 4 deep from the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three M5 holes tapped 6 deep in the top face, on the circle of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: load cell's flange holes (46 mm assumed), 60 degrees from the others.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: three M5 x 12 low-head screws hold the coupling under the spacer,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: heads 1 mm below its top; three M5 screws through the cell's flange

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the spacer. No screw crosses the spacer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no metal path from the coupling to the cell.
